title: pm-dispatch(review): a PR reaches a human only after the seat's ACCEPT and a same-head contract PASS: no seat assignee at the draft open, the approver request is the seat's hand-off, a PR landed owing a review is re-reviewed with findings filed as cards
body:
Fixes #27345
Fixes #27363
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把「PR 推给人审」的时点改为 **席位 ACCEPT + 现 head 契约复核 PASS 俱在案之后**:请审成为席位的交棒动作(中继 `pr_request_reviewers`;作者是审批人时 `assign`),dev 开 draft PR 不再带 `assignees`,中继 `pr_create` 不再在开 PR 那一刻请审;落地时仍欠复核的 PR 在落地 head 上复审,发现逐条立新卡;巡查 H43 只在交棒已到期而无人被请时才报。
- 为什么改:您的 GitHub 指派清单被没人复核过的 draft 填满,请审在席位审完之前就发出(「这个是技能的bug,应该是开发完了你审核通过才会推送给我审核」);三张 PR 在 PASS 之前或缺席时就被推到您面前并挂了 auto-merge(「没有完成复审就推送给我审核了」)。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文本、中继表的一个标记位(`pr_create` 的 `governedReview`)与一条只报不拦的巡查行;不新增门禁、不碰 workflow。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的三个 commit;中继 `pr_ready` 仍保留受管请审兜底(Tier H 的 ready 本就在批准之后),Tier H 的批准与合并仍是您的点击。
- 先看:① `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` 的 `pr_create` 行(`governedReview: true` 移除)与头部「The governed-review follow-up」节;② `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` L198–201(规则唯一一份);③ `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `h43HandoffReading` 与 `h43GovernedReviewRequestGap`(新的 `handoff` 门;unread 不判、before 不报、due 才报)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`,预期尾行 `209 cases pass across 20 batteries` 与 `5066 cases pass … H43 hand-off timing 89/80`;本 PR 自身就是首个样本:draft 开出时 `assignees` 与 `requested_reviewers` 皆空(见 Verification 的回读)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(路径面 `.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**`,Tier S:席位跑契约复审,PASS 后 ready → 入队)。

## What changes

The two cards are one rule at two points, so the rule is written once — SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉 ③ — and the other files point at it: a PR reaches a human only when development is done AND the seat's ACCEPT (`## 席位核对`) AND, where clause ② applies (every governed path is the review's `rules` face, so on every governed PR), a `## Contract review` PASS on the CURRENT head are on the PR; then, and only for Tier H, the seat requests review from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (`os-zhuang`, `hotlong`). The seat's own account is never assigned to or requested on a PR; a Tier S PR goes to no human; a head that moves after the PASS goes back to waiting.

### Card 27345 — the same-head PASS gates the ask, and a PR that landed owing a review is re-reviewed

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈路径分叉〉 L198–201, rewritten in place (four lines, same count): ③ the request IS the seat's hand-off after ACCEPT + same-head PASS, through `pr_request_reviewers`; the author-is-approver fallback stays (`assign` the author, request the others; never the seat's own account; Tier S hands off to nobody); `pr_create`/`pr_ready` request and assign nobody, a head that moves after the PASS goes back to waiting, an off-relay PR has the seat read its reviewers and assignees itself; the 速读 「需要你做的」 line that asks for approval names the PASS comment id and its `Head-sha`, and with no PASS says "contract review owed" and does not ask.
- `references/contract-review.md` L47 (was L49): the two pre-landing checks now gate the request and the ask as well — ① a same-head, same-shape, at-tier PASS on the current head. New L52–53 (item 2): a PR that lands while still owing a review is re-reviewed on its landed head by the lane seat or by triage under the gap rule (a)(b)(c); a FAIL is not repaired on the closed PR — each must-fix is filed as a NEW card citing the record, graded on its own; a revert only for a main red (p0, main-red 约定①) or a security boundary. Paid by folding the two wrapped pairs L34–35 (`Local-runs:`) and L43–44 (`--brief-template`) into one line each — every clause kept; the script path is spelled in full on L33 already.
- `references/landing-operations.md` L12: PASS ⇒ Tier S ready + auto-merge, Tier H hands off per SKILL.md ③; L13 points at the post-landing rule. Paid by deleting old L54, whose content (a contract-review-PASS PR arrives at the landing window already ready and armed) is L12's own statement.
- `references/lanes/director.md` L57: five checks in order before a governed PR waits for a human — seat record, 速读, same-head PASS, `pr_request_reviewers`, green head.

### Card 27363 — no seat assignee at the draft open; the approver request is the seat's hand-off

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L37/L60: a dev's `pr_create` carries no `assignees` (labels only — `skip-changeset` still rides the create); a human sees the PR at the seat's hand-off.
- `references/execution-duties.md` L63: 「PR assignee = 卡的」 and the takeover swap are gone; the in-flight-PR reader is `head:claude/` open PRs plus the card their body names (`Fixes`/`Part of`) — no PR assignee anywhere in it. The card's assignee and the `Claim:` `Branch:` still own the work.
- `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 L140 (item 4): a project thread does not perform the harness's post-create assign / request-review step; the request is the seat's hand-off — citing 「审核通过才会推送给我审核」. Paid by deleting old L136, whose three clauses (p1 first; the project-wide cap is the maintainer's; queue when full) are `coordinator.md` 三 L23–L25 verbatim, which the deleted line itself pointed at.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`: `governedReview: true` leaves the `pr_create` row — the draft open summons nobody; `GOVERNED_REVIEW_OPS` derives to `['pr_ready']`. The `assignees` leg stays optional on the row for the author-is-approver fallback and other callers; a dev simply stops sending it. **Hypothesis 1 measured:** the relay already has `pr_request_reviewers` (ops.mjs L1050: `pull` required, `reviewers`/`team_reviewers` with `atLeastOne`), so the hand-off is ONE seat stroke after ACCEPT + PASS; `pr_ready` keeps its follow-up as a backstop — a Tier H pull is readied only after an approver approved it, so there it costs zero writes when the hand-off was made and names the one approver still uncovered when it was not. Header sections rewritten accordingly (the maintainer's words quoted once).
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` / `validate.mjs`: headers and self-tests pin the derived op list as `pr_ready` alone and that a `pr_create` on a Tier H diff reads no file list, re-reads no pull or reviews, sends no request and no assignee (an approver-authored pull included), and that a create answering no number owes no follow-up (the stroke no longer fails on its account). The governed battery's create-side runs became `pr_ready` runs; three create NEGATIVE pins replace them (pin 29 → 30).
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H43 (item 5): before judging 「asked neither approver」 the row reads the PR's own issue-comment thread — H48's fetch class, cached so H48/H69 pay nothing — for the seat's ACCEPT (`SEAT_RECORD_MARKER` + `seatRecordAccepts`, seat-record.mjs) and a `## Contract review` naming the current head whose verdict word is PASS (`latestContractReviewOnHead`, widened with `verdict`; `contractReviewVerdictOf` is the one reader of the word, three measured dialects). Three states: unread ⇒ UNJUDGED (quiet, disclosed), before ⇒ not a half state (quiet), due ⇒ the existing coverage judgment. Only DUE buys the submitted-review page. Summary clause and two count keys (`governedHandoffRead`, `governedHandoffDue`) disclose the reading; drafts still neither fire nor silence it. Bound stated in the header: the PR thread is the one thread read — a PASS on the card alone reads as BEFORE (under-report only); the ACCEPT's freshness against the head stays H69's question. H69's header and sentence stopped saying 「the relay summons at `pr_create`」 (made false by this PR; its self-test pin moved with it).
- **Hypothesis 2 measured** (patrols reading PR assignees as ownership): none. `check-handover.mjs` (a) reads CARD assignees and puts pull requests out of its population (its self-test pins it); `check-half-states.mjs` reads a PR's `assignees` only as H43's approver-coverage fallback, kept on purpose (the fallback assigns an approver, never a seat). `project-forms.md` L31–32: the ledger is labels + the card's assignee + `Claim:` + `head:claude/` PRs — already assignee-free on the PR side, no edit.
- **Hypothesis 3**: confirmed with one adjustment — `locateReviewOfRecord` itself is not called: it requires BOTH threads (PR and card) or answers `unreadable`, and reads no verdict word; H43 reuses its building blocks (`latestContractReviewOnHead`, the one head-sha recogniser `record-recognisers.mjs` imports) and adds the verdict word beside them.
- **Hypothesis 4**: the `Regen-provenance` pair (contract-review L50–51) does not compress under 120 B; the `Local-runs:` and `--brief-template` pairs do, so they paid; landing-operations L7–8 kept, old L54 paid instead.

Expected direction for every leg: turn red (常态). Observed:

1. `ops.mjs` — `governedReview: true` planted back on `pr_create` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob 2abc5979 → f52678f1, restored to 2abc5979). `validate.mjs --self-test` exit 1 with the named pin red: 「the governed-review follow-up runs after exactly pr_ready … 1 of 216 case(s) failed」. `execute.mjs --self-test` exit 1 by a TypeError at L1303 (the requests battery's `pr_create` + `issue_create` stroke stopped after the create — the re-enabled follow-up asked for `GET …/pulls/9/files`, which the fixtures no longer prime — so the second write never happened): red by crash at the first create-side case the mutation reaches, before the ⭐ negative pin itself was evaluated.
   - A first attempt of this leg was a NO-OP and is recorded as such: the replacement text re-contained the anchor, the tool refused (anchor count 1 → 1, not the declared drop), the child never ran, nothing was written. Re-anchored on the row's unique comment line and re-run as above.
2. `execute.mjs` — the follow-up forced to run after `pr_create` again (`action.op === 'pr_create' ||`). `execute.mjs --self-test` exit 1, same TypeError at L1303 for the same reason (a follow-up after the create), red by crash. Restored to ddd1bfaa == HEAD.
3. `check-half-states.mjs` — the hand-off gate `if (handoff?.state !== 'due') return null;` deleted. `--self-test` exit 1 by a TypeError at `h43GovernedReviewRequestGap` (`handoff.record` on an undefined hand-off, reached from the 「an UNREAD thread is UNJUDGED」 pin): red by crash at exactly the pin the gate protects. Restored to f5c5c23f == HEAD.
4. `check-half-states.mjs` — `contractReviewVerdictOf` answering `PASS` for every explicit `VERDICT:` line. `--self-test` exit 1 with 6 named ✗ cases, among them 「a FAIL on the current head is BEFORE (got "due,PASS", want "before,FAIL")」, 「the newest PASS on the head decides, and a FAIL after it withdraws the hand-off」, 「`**VERDICT: PASS**` reads PASS, and FAIL reads FAIL」, 「the explicit VERDICT line wins over prose」. Restored to f5c5c23f == HEAD.
5. `check-half-states.mjs` (3b, the non-crash reading of leg 3) — the gate narrowed to `unread`/`undefined` only, so BEFORE is no longer quiet. `--self-test` exit 1 with ONE named ✗ case out of 5066: 「H43 row: ⛔ BEFORE the hand-off, nobody asked is NOT a half state — quiet」 (it got the finding sentence, wanted null); every DUE case stayed green, so the mutation moved exactly the predicate the card asks for. Restored to f5c5c23f == HEAD; `git status --porcelain` empty after every leg.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `AGENTS.md` (Tier H, outside this dispatch's file list and not edited here) still says in 〈Multi-agent working discipline〉 「the PR's assignee mirrors the card's, set by the executor at pr_create」 — contradicted by os-dev.md L37 after this PR. One sentence to retire; it needs the maintainer's hand on a Tier H file. carrier: the seat (`domain:skills#2`) files it or hands it to triage; noted here, not filed by the dev.
- Card 26617 is untouched and stays `pm:on-hold`: its shape 1 (the approver request moves off `pr_create`) is implemented here; triage decides its disposition after landing.
- PRs already in flight with a person assigned are not unassigned here (card 27363 item 6).
- The claude.ai project-harness step itself is outside this repo; only the thread line (dispatch-runbook.md L140) tells a thread not to perform it.
- In-file adjacency edited: H69's header and sentence in `check-half-states.mjs` claimed the relay summons at `pr_create`; this PR makes that false, so the two spots (and the one self-test pin on the words) now describe the hand-off. No row semantics changed for H69.
- `latestContractReviewOnHead` now returns `verdict` beside `id` and `sha` (additive; `record-recognisers.mjs` does not import it).
- This PR is the first to follow the rule it writes: its `pr_create` carried no `assignees` while os-dev.md L37 on `main` still said to send one — the seat ruled the omission for this PR on both claims.
- Not run locally: `test:repo` (CI's `Test Core`), the lint sweep, dogfood (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm); every CI family is read from the PR's check-runs by the seat.
- No `.github/workflows/**` line was needed; no new gate, script or workflow.
